lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr2Mn4Mo4 (Zr(MnMo)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn and Mo centers each adopt close-packed-like 12-neighbor environments, while Zr centers have 16 geometric neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mn and Mo 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Mn and Zr polyhedra.
